input_scope: W6 ZIP, its selected initializations and frozen normal-prefix caches only
stream: canonical meta_support then meta_query; 70 unique images; view = event_index modulo 4
fixture_order: first eight canonical identities, all four mask views
center_region: rows and columns 12:16 in the canonical 28x28 grid
freeze_policy: compute both pre-event local gradients and normal clocks; retain the frozen level's preceding weights; counters record scheduled commits, actual applications separately
visual_off_policy: same learned weights; fixed-map visual readout during both stream adaptation and scoring
gradient_policy: read-only local/final partial derivative alignment plus one hypothetical event on a separate state; never retain its proposed state
purpose: causal diagnostics of an already observed v3 pilot; not new scientific selection or anomaly evaluation
probe_exposure: previously inspected; development/forensic evidence, not untouched confirmation for a future revision
interpretation: Compare same-history trajectories, current-vs-local objectives and spatial contraction; no normal-only result establishes AUROC/AUPR or cross-task retention. Freeze interventions are not retrained deployable methods.
